_comment: GLOBAL config — install at ~/.codex-channel-octo/config.json. Holds SHARED defaults + the list of bots to run. It does NOT hold a botToken: each bot's token lives in ~/.codex-channel-octo/<id>/config.json (see config.bot.example.json). The directory containing THIS file is the baseDir; every bot is a self-contained subtree at <baseDir>/<id>/{config.json, SOUL.md, data/, workspace/, codex-home/}, all auto-created. Per-bot dirs are NOT configurable — they are always derived from baseDir + id, so a bot can never escape its subtree.
_comment_bots: Which bots to run. Each entry's `id` selects its subtree <baseDir>/<id>/ and its per-bot config.json. A single bot is just one entry, conventionally id 'default'. Per-bot config.json overrides anything here.
_comment_group_config_dir: Optional directory of per-group instruction files (<groupId>.md), injected as trusted project instructions (AGENTS.md). Operator-controlled — keep it OUTSIDE every bot's workspace (the agent can write there). Omit to disable.

sdk._comment_codex_base_url: Optional self-hosted Codex provider base URL (e.g. a private gateway). Passed to new Codex({ baseUrl }). Must be https:// (or http://localhost for dev) — SSRF-validated at boot. Omit to use codex's configured default.
sdk._comment_codex_api_key: Optional API key for the Codex provider, passed to new Codex({ apiKey }). Alternatively authenticate per-bot via `codex login` against the bot's codex-home.
sdk._comment_sandbox: sandboxMode defaults to 'read-only'. For sandboxed editing set BOTH allowWorkspaceWrite=true AND sandboxMode='workspace-write'. For a dedicated externally isolated container, explicitly set sandboxMode='danger-full-access' to disable Codex sandboxing (see config.bot.docker.example.json).
sdk._comment_approval: approvalPolicy: never | on-request | on-failure | untrusted. Default 'never' (headless — no human to answer). The real boundary is sandboxMode, not this.
sdk._comment_effort: modelReasoningEffort: minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh. Default 'medium'. NOTE: 'minimal' conflicts with web search.
sdk._comment_network: networkAccessEnabled / webSearchEnabled default false. danger-full-access has unrestricted Codex network access regardless of networkAccessEnabled; use container/network policy to restrict it.
sdk._comment_tool_progress: Set toolProgress=true to post redacted '🔧 <action>…' progress notices as codex works (command/file/tool — never stdout, diff, or full args). Off by default.

_comment_mention_free: group_ids listed here process every text message without requiring an @bot mention.
